prayerExcerpt.en-US: “Follow me.” And he rose and followed Him.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: “Segue-me.” E ele se levantou e O seguiu.

meta.face: An old man around 70, long straight white hair, a long flowing undivided white beard reaching the chest, calm scholarly expression.
meta.basis: Old man with a long beard (Painter's Manual); undivided to set him apart from Andrew.

sources.title: Dionysius of Fourna, The Painter's Manual (Hermeneia), c. 1730 — Didron's 1845 French edition

history.note: Face edited to break the stock look-alike face shared by most male cards
